messages:
deploybot: [ALERT] Hotfix rollout for auth-proxy v4.1.1-canary showing elevated 5xx (10.8%) in eu-west1, automatic pause engaged. Requesting expedited decision: pin to v4.1.0 or abort.

ron: Noted. Is the error correlated with a specific customer or route?

deploybot: Failures concentrated on /v1/tokenize route for long payloads; internal tests reproducing tokenization faults.

anya: We just entered a support SLA window. My vote is to pin to redwood/auth-proxy:v4.1.0-stable and scale down the canary. Ops, can you escort and watch for 15m?

ops_oncall: I can take it. If pinned, I'll monitor error_rate, p95 latency, and pod readiness. If errors remain >5% after 10m, escalate to SRE.

ron: Executing pin now:
```
/releasebot pin --service auth-proxy --image redwood/auth-proxy:v4.1.0-stable --reason "canary regressions v4.1.1 tokenization" --urgency expedited --owner ron
```

releasebot: Pin command received. Verifying image signature and deploy policy... OK. Applying pin and starting traffic rebalance (ETA ~35s).

deploybot: Reroute complete. Traffic pinned to redwood/auth-proxy:v4.1.0-stable. v4.1.1 canary scaled down.

anya: Drafted brief for release notes: "Pinned to v4.1.0 due to tokenization failures in v4.1.1 canary. Investigation assigned to ron/team." Link will be posted.

ops_oncall: Monitoring: error_rate back to baseline ~0.5%, p95 normalized. Holding for 15m per expedite policy.

ron: I will collect canary logs and start a bisect on the tokenization change set.

ops_oncall: +18m stable, no anomalies. Closing expedite window and marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
